report: Refile of 8-parcel-tx-thc (that one used 'sites' objects with street addresses, the wrong shape for kind=parcel -- it needs 'points' as [lat,lon] pairs, got 0 results). 11 Texas Historical Commission state historic sites, all P-2 no-hit or a container-only hit, using POTA pin coordinates (refs and points are parallel arrays, same order). US-10276 Star of the Republic Museum and US-6538 Barrington Plantation both sit inside Washington-on-the-Brazos SHS (PAD-US 261746, 295 ac) -- that shape is a different, bigger record (R-G8); need each site's own smaller parcel, not that container. If StratMap has no coverage for a county, say so rather than guessing.
